name: Aegis AI Inspection Proxy
description: An x402-protected proxy that checks allowlisted vendor JSON responses before settling payment.
author: Aegis AI Team
manifest_note: Project metadata for the discovery endpoint. PayBox marketplace registration schema and submission process have not been independently verified.

capabilities.name: inspect_and_pay
capabilities.description: Forward a request to an allowlisted vendor. In x402 mode, exact payment is verified before the request and settled only after inspection passes; failed inspection is not settled. This is conditional settlement, not escrow.

parameters.target_url: string (required) - HTTPS endpoint on an exact VENDOR_ALLOWLIST hostname resolving only to public IPv4
parameters.expected_key: string (optional) - Dotted JSON key path required in the vendor response
parameters.payload: object (optional) - JSON body forwarded to the vendor

payment.settlement: after successful response inspection; no charge on inspection failure
